in_marathi.name: Kallu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kallu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kallu is derived from the Hindi language. It is a diminutive form of the name Kal or Kala, which means 'black' or 'dark'. In Hindu mythology, the god Shiva is often referred to as Kala, signifying time and the destroyer of all illusions. Kallu can be seen as a playful and endearing name for a little boy, representing the protective and nurturing qualities of the divine being Shiva.
